known_limitations: A 12-month administrative embargo interval applies before an accepted manuscript appears. Recent DOE-funded work is therefore systematically absent, and an empty result for a 2026 paper means "not yet released", not "does not exist".

DOIs arrive as full https://doi.org/ URLs rather than bare DOIs, which breaks naive deduplication against OSTI.GOV records of the same work. The adapter normalizes both to a bare DOI and keeps the URL form as the locator.
Sixteen times smaller than OSTI.GOV (260K against 4.38M) by design, not by omission. A literature search that finds nothing here should try OSTI.GOV before concluding anything.

warnings.message: No published rate limit, same as the rest of the OSTI family.
Restricted to DOE PAGES, which holds public-access literature after a 12-month administrative embargo. Recent work is systematically absent; search without public_access_only to see the wider index.
